title: Robot Rescue
shortDescription: Robot Rescue is included in GameAtlas's Nintendo DSi family puzzle route, alongside deterministic catalog context and a linked Wikidata item.
highlights: Sets a direct-reference puzzle marker within the Nintendo DSi family catalog.
Keeps the external item link distinct from the deterministic catalog method.
